name: Snakeskin Corset
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 7th; Slot body; Price 15,000 gp; Weight 0.5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This fine corset is made of multiple complementary strips of snakeskin.

The snakeskin corset grants its wearer a +4 resistance bonus on saves against poison and disease.

Additionally, once per day as a move action, the wearer can take the shape of an emperor cobra as though by beast shape iii.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells beast shape iii; Price 7,500 gp
